description: Compositional conservation of KRT9 glycine-rich end domains between human and mouse
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def rec(a): return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=60).json()

m = rec("Q6IFX2")
print("Q6IFX2 =", m["organism"]["scientificName"], "|", [g["geneName"]["value"] for g in m.get("genes",[])],
      "| len", m["sequence"]["length"])

def regions_of(r):
    s=r["sequence"]["value"]
    rod=[f for f in r["features"] if f["type"]=="Domain" and "IF rod" in f.get("description","")]
    st,en=rod[0]["location"]["start"]["value"], rod[0]["location"]["end"]["value"]
    return s[:st-1], s[st-1:en], s[en:]

h_head,h_rod,h_tail = regions_of(rec("P35527"))
m_head,m_rod,m_tail = regions_of(m)

def frac(s,aa): return 100*sum(s.count(c) for c in aa)/len(s)
print("\nCompositional comparison of the low-complexity end domains (human vs mouse KRT9):")
print(f"{'':<16}{'len':>6}{'Gly%':>8}{'Ser%':>8}{'Gly+Ser%':>10}{'charged%':>10}")
for nm,s in [("human head",h_head),("mouse head",m_head),("human tail",h_tail),("mouse tail",m_tail),
             ("human rod",h_rod),("mouse rod",m_rod)]:
    print(f"{nm:<16}{len(s):>6}{frac(s,'G'):>8.1f}{frac(s,'S'):>8.1f}{frac(s,'GS'):>10.1f}{frac(s,'DEKR'):>10.1f}")

# Count GGG-type glycine loop motifs
import re
for nm,s in [("human tail",h_tail),("mouse tail",m_tail),("human head",h_head),("mouse head",m_head)]:
    loops=re.findall(r"G{3,}", s)
    print(f"{nm}: {len(loops)} runs of >=3 consecutive Gly, longest = {max((len(x) for x in loops), default=0)}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5,4.4))
labels=["human\nhead","mouse\nhead","human\nrod","mouse\nrod","human\ntail","mouse\ntail"]
segs=[h_head,m_head,h_rod,m_rod,h_tail,m_tail]
g=[frac(s,'G') for s in segs]; se=[frac(s,'S') for s in segs]; ch=[frac(s,'DEKR') for s in segs]
x=np.arange(6); w=0.26
ax.bar(x-w,g,w,label="Gly",color="#3b6ea5"); ax.bar(x,se,w,label="Ser",color="#c0763a")
ax.bar(x+w,ch,w,label="charged (D,E,K,R)",color="#2f6f4e")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("percent of residues")
ax.set_title("KRT9 end domains conserve amino acid composition, not sequence, between human and mouse")
ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
